title.en: Can one small model check two universal links?
title.ru: Может ли одна маленькая модель проверить две универсальные связи?

hypothesis.en: A frozen Qwen3-0.6B can separately decide whether an exact quote supports a proposed answer and whether that proposed answer helps answer the user's question, without domain-specific fields such as device, person, time, or situation.
hypothesis.ru: Замороженная Qwen3-0.6B может отдельно решить, подтверждает ли точная цитата предложенный ответ и помогает ли этот ответ вопросу пользователя, без специальных полей вроде устройства, человека, времени или ситуации.

plain_language.en: We check two bridges: quote to claim, then claim to question. Ordinary code combines the two decisions.
plain_language.ru: Проверяем два мостика: от цитаты к утверждению, затем от утверждения к вопросу. Два решения соединяет обычный код.

model.decision_method: next-token choice among the single tokens A, B, and C

links.question: Does the exact quote support the proposed answer in the context of the user's question?
If the proposed answer were true, would it help answer the user's question?

locked_reporting: show all 32 question, claim, and exact-quote triples
show both A/B/C scores and both decisions for every case
show the deterministic final TAKE, DROP, or NOT_SURE decision
report each of the four quadrants separately
not_tested: whether a source is true or trustworthy
whether the sender selected the best quote
phone speed, heat, memory, or battery
claim_boundary: This is one small public synthetic English development test. It measures two text relations on frozen examples. It is not proof of truth, safety, phone viability, or general real-world understanding.
